PreToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(uv run uvicorn|uv run fastapi dev|python -m uvicorn|fastapi dev)"

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')

# Block dev servers that aren't run in tmux
echo '[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in tmux for log access' >&2
echo '[Hook] Use this command instead:' >&2
echo "[Hook] tmux new-session -d -s dev 'uv run fastapi dev app/main.py'" >&2
echo '[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev' >&2
exit 1

PreToolUse.description: tmux外での開発サーバー起動をブロック (Linux)

PreToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(uv sync|uv add|pip install|poetry install|pytest|alembic|docker|playwright)"

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
if [ -z "$TMUX" ]; then
  echo '[Hook] Consider running in tmux for session persistence' >&2
  echo '[Hook] tmux new -s dev  |  tmux attach -t dev' >&2
fi
echo "$input"

PreToolUse.description: 長時間コマンドでのtmux推奨リマインダー (Linux)

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Open editor for review before pushing
echo '[Hook] Review changes before push...' >&2
echo '[Hook] Press Enter to continue with push or Ctrl+C to abort...' >&2
read -r

#!/bin/bash
# Block creation of unnecessary documentation files
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')

if [[ "$file_path" =~ \.(md|txt)$ ]] && [[ ! "$file_path" =~ (README|CLAUDE|AGENTS|CONTRIBUTING)\.md$ ]]; then
  echo "[Hook] BLOCKED: Unnecessary documentation file creation" >&2
  echo "[Hook] File: $file_path" >&2
  echo "[Hook] Use README.md for documentation instead" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "$input"

PreToolUse.description: 不要なドキュメント作成のブロック

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Auto-detect PR creation
input=$(cat)
cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command')

if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'gh pr create'; then
  output=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_output.output // ""')
  pr_url=$(echo "$output" | grep -oE 'https://github.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/pull/[0-9]+')
  if [ -n "$pr_url" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] PR created: $pr_url" >&2
  fi
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
# Auto-format and check with Ruff
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  uv run ruff format "$file_path" 2>&1 | head -5 >&2
  uv run ruff check --fix "$file_path" 2>&1 | head -5 >&2
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
# Run mypy
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  uv run mypy "$file_path" --no-error-summary 2>&1 | grep -E "(error|warning)" | head -10 >&2 || true
fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
# Final check for print statements
input=$(cat)
if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  modified_files=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.py$' || true)
  if [ -n "$modified_files" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r file; do
      if [ -f "$file" ] && grep -q "^[^#]*\bprint(" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "[Hook] WARNING: print() found in $file" >&2
      fi
    done <<< "$modified_files"
  fi
fi
echo "$input"
